key:
To enter the door of your choice, you must first select the number you think is in the bronze cage.

Just click on that cage to assign a number.

You can also do the same with the other cages.

Each correct guess will grant you one gold coin upon entering the correct door.
en:
To enter the door of your choice, you must first select the number you think is in the bronze cage.

Just click on that cage to assign a number.

You can also do the same with the other cages.

Each correct guess will grant you one gold coin upon entering the correct door.
fr:
Pour entrer dans la porte de ton choix, tu dois d’abord sélectionner le nombre que tu penses être dans la cage de bronze.

Clique dessus pour lui assigner un nombre.

Tu peux aussi faire la même chose avec les autres cages.

Chaque nombre correct te fera gagner une pièce après être passé par la bonne porte.

key:
Oh no... You lost all your lives.

Clicking on the retry button here will grant you one life potion for your next run.
en:
Oh no... You lost all your lives.

Clicking on the retry button here will grant you one life potion for your next run.
fr:
Oh non... Tu as perdu toutes tes vies.

Cliquer sur le bouton Réessayer te donnera une potion de vie pour ta prochaine partie.

key: Alright, I'll tell you. The correct door is the right one.
en: Alright, I'll tell you. The correct door is the right one.
fr: Ok, je vais te dire. La bonne porte est celle de droite.

key: I will reveal one random number at the start of each floor
en: I will reveal one random number at the start of each floor.
fr:
Je révélerai un
nombre au début de chaque niveau

key: The next floors are dangerous. I'll let you buy two of my charms.
en: The next floors are dangerous. I'll let you buy two of my charms.
fr: Les prochains niveaux sont dangereux, je te laisse acheter deux de mes amulettes

key: The goal of each floor is to choose the door which corresponds to the correct answer to the question.
en: The goal of each floor is to choose the door which corresponds to the correct answer to the question.
fr: Le but de chaque niveau est de choisir la porte qui correspond à la bonne réponse.

key:
To find it, you have to listen to what the numbers in the cages say.
[shake rate=20.0 level=5 connected=1]Careful[/shake]: every number will say the truth except the number 1, which will always lie.
en:
To find it, you have to listen to what the numbers in the cages say.
[shake rate=20.0 level=5 connected=1]Careful[/shake]: every number will say the truth except the number 1, which will always lie.
fr:
Pour la trouver, tu dois écouter ce que les nombres dans les cages ont à dire,
[shake rate=20.0 level=5 connected=1]Attention[/shake] : tous les nombres disent la vérité sauf le nombre 1 qui ment toujours.

key: Your Crystal Ball can help you guess what the numbers in the cages are. The numbers appearing in it are the numbers locked in the cages. Also note that there is always only one number 1 on each floor.
en: Your Crystal Ball can help you guess what the numbers in the cages are. The numbers appearing in it are the numbers locked in the cages. Also note that there is always only one number 1 on each floor.
fr:
Ta boule de cristal te permet de déterminer quels nombres sont dans les cages.
Les nombres à l’intérieur sont ceux dans les cages du niveau.
Note : Il n’y a qu’un seul 1 par niveau.

key: You will be able to click the cages to assign the number you think is locked in. At the end of the floor, each correct guess will be rewarded with 1 gold coin.
en: You will be able to click the cages to assign the number you think is locked in. At the end of the floor, each correct guess will be rewarded with 1 gold coin.
fr: Tu pourras cliquer sur les cages pour assigner le nombre que tu pense être enfermé à l’intérieur. À la fin du niveau, chaque bonne réponse sera récompensée par une pièce d’or.

key:
Can you figure out who is lying here with the help of your crystal ball?
Once you have guessed what numbers are inside the cages, enter the correct door by clicking on it.
en:
Can you figure out who is lying here with the help of your crystal ball?
Once you have guessed what numbers are inside the cages, enter the correct door by clicking on it.
fr:
Peux-tu déterminer qui ment ici à l’aide de ta boule de cristal ?
Dès que tu auras déterminé quels nombres sont dans les cages, passe par la bonne porte en cliquant dessus.

key: Sometimes, it will be impossible to know the solution. This is a good occasion to use items. Choosing the wrong door will cost you a heart.
en: Sometimes, it will be impossible to know the solution. This is a good occasion to use items. Choosing the wrong door will cost you a heart.
fr: Parfois, il peut être impossible de connaître la solution. C’est un bon moment pour utiliser un item. Choisir une mauvaise porte te fera perdre un cœur.

key: If you collect enough gold by clicking on cages and assigning the right number, you may buy items at the shops you will find on your path.
en: If you collect enough gold by clicking on cages and assigning the right number, you may buy items at the shops you will find on your path.
fr: Collecter assez de pièces d’or en cliquant sur les cages et en assignant le bon nombre te permettra d’acheter des items dans la boutique sur ton chemin.

key: Try using the magnifying glass (on the left) by clicking on it, to see what it does!
en: Try using the magnifying glass (on the left) by clicking on it, to see what it does!
fr: Essaie d’utiliser la loupe (à gauche de l’écran) en cliquant dessus pour appliquer son effet.

key:
Deep under the earth, you find riches that were long forgotten.

Climbing back out of the dungeon, you realize all numbers has been freed from their cages.

Where might they have gone and why were they locked in the first place?
[font_size=50]You win![/font_size]
en:
Deep under the earth, you find riches that were long forgotten.

Climbing back out of the dungeon, you realize all numbers has been freed from their cages.

Where might they have gone and why were they locked in the first place?
[font_size=50]You win![/font_size]
fr:
Au plus profond de la terre, tu trouves un trésor très ancien.

En remontant le donjon, tu réalises que tous les nombres ont été libérés de leurs cages.

Où ont-ils bien pu aller et pourquoi étaient-ils enfermés initialement ?
[font_size=50]VICTOIRE[/font_size]
